1.name: Knowledge
1.action: Track the trail. Attend to what can be learned.

2.name: Wisdom
2.root: *weid- — to see, to know by seeing
2.action: See clearly. Apply what was seen before.

3.name: Understanding
3.action: Stand on the common ground beneath the two.

4.name: Cultured Freedom
4.action: Work the freedom. Till it; it is freedom only once made.

5.name: Powered Refinement
5.root: posse + finis — capacity meeting its limit
5.action: Show the full capacity. Name what bounds it.

6.name: Equality
6.action: Measure what is level. Redistribute what is not.

7.name: Consciousness
7.action: Hold the whole. Coordinate, not effort.

8.name: Build/Destroy
8.root: *bʰuH- + *strew- — to bring into being and scatter
8.action: Build what endures. Release what obstructs.

9.name: Birth
9.action: Carry what is new. Bring it across the threshold.
